title: 2025 Topps #T90-96 Willie Mays San Francisco Giants Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2025 Topps trading card celebrating the 35th Anniversary of Willie Mays' time with the San Francisco Giants. This standard-sized card features the legendary baseball player in his Major League (MLB) team, the San Francisco Giants. Manufactured by Topps, this original card is a must-have for fans of baseball and collectors alike. It is a special piece of memorabilia that pays tribute to one of the greatest players in baseball history.
